title: Stage opt-in native WebRTC screen viewing for Linux, macOS and Windows.
changes: Add a session-scoped native WebRTC media bridge behind explicit device and website consent, with platform-specific capture boundaries, per-session Stop and timeouts.
Support Windows interactive-session capture and macOS Screen Recording permission checks; keep synthetic media for isolated Linux QA only.
Reject untrusted worker binaries, owner-writable paths, arbitrary TURN configuration, replayed sessions and expired ephemeral relay credentials.
Preserve the v0.2.252 App Engine and Windows application inventory; no automatic remote screen access or control is enabled.

Add an opt-in fail-closed E2EE requirement (REMCP_REQUIRE_E2EE=1): the agent refuses to start or connect to the current TLS-only relay rather than silently downgrade. This does not enable E2EE; unset/0 keeps existing behavior.

Native unsigned worker binaries remain separately packaged QA candidates, not shipped by the public npm runtime; Windows ARM64, macOS ARM64 and Linux x64 passed local media/Stop QA. WAN/TLS and public installer acceptance remain pending.
